I am 79 years old. I farm 4.1 mu in Quzhou with my wife. Just the two of us. I went to primary school, so I can read the bag labels and count the money. Seventy years I have been doing this.

My land is small. Every bag of fertilizer is money out of my pocket. But a bad harvest is worse than spending a few extra yuan. So I do not cut back too much.

For wheat in winter — I plant the improved variety, same one the seed shop in town sells. Jimai or whatever they have. My neighbors all use it, gives good yield. I plant maybe 15 kg seed per mu, a bit thick because I am old and cannot always replant gaps.

Before planting wheat I spread compound fertilizer, the 15-15-15 kind. About 50 kg per mu as base. Then in spring when wheat turns green, I top-dress urea, maybe 20 kg per mu. That is what I always do.

Water — I irrigate wheat 3 times. Once before winter to keep it warm, once at returning green in spring, once at filling. The well is there, the electricity is not too expensive.

Pesticide — I spray maybe 2 times. Once for weeds in spring, once for aphids and rust around April-May. If I see bugs I spray, if not I save the money.

Tillage — I pay the tractor man to rotary till. My back cannot plough anymore. 

For maize after wheat harvest — summer maize, I plant Zhengdan or Xianyu hybrid seed. Direct seed into the wheat stubble, no plough. I put compound fertilizer when planting, about 40 kg per mu, then urea top-dress at big trumpet stage, 25 kg per mu.

Maize I water 2 times if no rain — at jointing and tasseling. If summer rain is good, maybe only once.

Pesticide on maize — 1 or 2 times. Mostly for armyworm and corn borer.

Wheat I expect 450 kg per mu in a normal year. Maize 550 kg per mu. That is about what I get.
